description: The Master of Science in Business Administration program is designed for students who have earned an undergraduate degree in business and are seeking to advance their knowledge and skills beyond the bachelor’s degree in business. This program will equip students with advanced business knowledge across various functional areas and will emphasize the development of critical thinking, problem-solving, and communication skills through a rigorous curriculum. Graduates will be prepared to assume management and leadership positions in a wide range of industries and organizations, leveraging their enhanced understanding of business principles and practices to drive organizational success.
Program name: Master of Science in Business Administration

description: The Master of Science in Business Analytics (MSBA) program is an interdisciplinary program designed to educate students in the fundamental concepts and tools of business analytics and data sciences. The program provides the necessary knowledge for students to launch or accelerate their careers in the rapidly growing field of business analytics, which includes areas such as business intelligence, web analytics, big data, social media analytics, and various other related fields. Students will learn the essentials of statistical and econometric methods, prediction, optimization, and simulation. The MSBA program is a STEM-designated program.
Program name: Master of Science in Business Analytics

description: The Master of Business for Veterans (MBV) degree at the USC Marshall School of Business is an intensive, one-year graduate program designed to leverage the management and leadership experience veterans gained in the military and prepare them for new careers in the private sector. The curriculum focuses on business fundamentals and experiential learning to provide students with the skills they need to lead and manage in the 21st century. The MBV program is tailored for military veterans, active duty personnel, and transitioning professionals who want to sharpen their business acumen, expand their leadership capabilities, and build a strong professional network. The program's cohort model fosters a collaborative learning environment where veterans can share their unique perspectives and experiences, creating a powerful network of support and camaraderie.
Program name: Master of Business for Veterans

description: The Master of Science in Business Research degree provides advanced training in the theoretical and methodological foundations of business research. The program is specifically designed for students interested in pursuing doctoral study in business and related fields. The program prepares students to understand and conduct rigorous, evidence-based research by developing their knowledge of core theories and research methods in various business disciplines, including accounting, finance, marketing, management, and operations. Graduates of the program will be well-equipped to undertake PhD-level research and to contribute to the advancement of business knowledge.
Program name: Master of Science in Business Research

description: The Master of Science in Entrepreneurship and Innovation prepares students to be leaders and innovators in new and existing organizations. Graduates of the program will have the tools to develop innovative ideas, launch new ventures, and manage the process of innovation within a corporate setting. The program helps students understand the dynamics of entrepreneurship and innovation; acquire the skills to identify, assess and develop new venture opportunities; develop the skills to innovate and execute new business models within existing organizations; and develop the ability to plan, manage and fund new ventures.
Program name: Master of Science in Entrepreneurship and Innovation

description: The Master of Science in Finance (MSF) program at the USC Marshall School of Business is designed to provide students with a comprehensive and rigorous education in the principles and practices of finance. The program prepares graduates for a wide range of careers in the financial industry, including investment management, corporate finance, risk management, and financial analysis. The curriculum emphasizes both theoretical foundations and practical applications, equipping students with strong analytical and quantitative skills. Students will gain expertise in areas such as financial modeling, valuation, portfolio management, derivatives, and fixed income. The MSF program is STEM-designated, allowing international students to apply for an optional 24-month STEM OPT extension. The program requires 30 units of graduate-level course work, consisting of 12 units of core courses and 18 units of elective courses. Students typically complete the program in one academic year (three semesters).
Program name: Master of Science in Finance

description: The USC Marshall Master of Science in Food Industry Leadership is a rigorous, 16-month, 26-unit master’s degree program designed to provide current and aspiring leaders within the food industry with the advanced business and leadership skills necessary to drive success in this dynamic and evolving sector. Delivered by the internationally recognized USC Marshall School of Business, this program offers a unique blend of theoretical knowledge and practical insights, preparing graduates to navigate complex challenges, foster innovation, and lead with confidence in a global food landscape. Through a comprehensive curriculum, students will develop expertise in areas critical to the food industry, including supply chain management, finance, marketing, strategy, and analytics, all while emphasizing ethical leadership and sustainable practices.
Program name: Master of Science in Food Industry Leadership

description: The Master of Science in Global Supply Chain Management provides students with a fundamental understanding of global supply chain management as well as the analytical skills to design, analyze and manage global supply chains. The program is designed for students who want to develop careers in the areas of sourcing, operations, logistics, distribution, and supply chain management. The Master of Science in Global Supply Chain Management is a STEM designated program and is a member of the elite MIT Global SCALE Network. USC Marshall School of Business is the only partner in the Global SCALE Network that offers the MS GSCM program in a full-time, on-campus format.
Program name: Master of Science in Global Supply Chain Management (On-Campus/Residential)

description: The Master of Science in Global Supply Chain Management for Executives (Online) is a specialized graduate degree for mid-career professionals who wish to develop deeper supply chain expertise and lead major supply chain initiatives for their organizations. This 22-month, fully online program is taught by Marshall faculty and leverages Marshall’s top-ranked MBA and MS Global Supply Chain Management curriculum. This program is for professionals with at least eight years of work experience, of which five years are in supply chain or operations management. Applicants for this program must demonstrate that they will hold an executive position or executive level responsibilities upon completion of the program. Students will develop a keen understanding of core functional areas of global supply chain management including sourcing, operations, logistics, and information technology with an emphasis on current and future trends. Graduates of the program will be prepared to lead supply chain initiatives at a strategic level and possess an extensive understanding of the global business environment. This degree also gives students an opportunity to learn best practices and develop a strong network of supply chain professionals.
Program name: Master of Science in Global Supply Chain Management for Executives (Online)

description: The Master of Management in Library and Information Science (MMLIS) program from the USC Bovard College prepares students for leadership roles in libraries and information centers by blending traditional library science with modern management skills. Designed for working professionals, the MMLIS is a fully online, asynchronous program that can be completed in as little as 2 years. Students in the MMLIS program will acquire skills and knowledge in key areas, including: Information organization, access, and retrieval; Management and administration of libraries and information centers; Digital libraries and archives; Information technology and systems; Data management and analytics; User experience (UX) and service design; Information policy, ethics, and law; Research methods and data analysis; Professional development and leadership.
Accreditation status: The Master of Management in Library and Information Science (MMLIS) program is not accredited by the American Library Association (ALA).
Program name: Master of Management in Library and Information Science

description: The Master of Management Studies (M.M.S.) is an intensive full-time program designed for recent graduates and young professionals, as well as those transitioning into a new career, to strengthen their foundational knowledge in business and management. The program provides students with an understanding of management concepts and practices through required course work in subjects such as accounting, business analytics, communications, finance, leadership, marketing and operations. Students may select from a variety of elective courses in functional areas such as accounting, business analytics, entrepreneurship, finance, management, marketing, operations and supply chain management and strategy. The curriculum helps students develop the critical thinking, communication and problem-solving skills needed to lead in a dynamic business world. The M.M.S. is a 33-unit program that can be completed in two semesters and includes experiential learning opportunities designed to give students practical experience.
Program name: Master of Management Studies

description: This STEM-designated program focuses on the technical aspects of data analytics necessary to deliver superior marketing results and drive strategic business decisions. It prepares students for successful careers in marketing analytics, digital marketing, marketing research, and product/brand management.
Program name: Master of Science in Marketing (Marketing Analytics)

description: The Master of Science in Marketing program is designed to provide students with the conceptual and analytical skills required to become leaders in modern data-intensive marketing environments. The program will enable students to develop competence in marketing analytics, marketing research, and marketing strategy. The program is specifically designed to meet the growing demand for quantitatively trained professionals in marketing across a wide array of industries. Upon graduation, students will be prepared for a variety of marketing positions that require strong analytical and quantitative skills, such as marketing analyst, marketing consultant, marketing researcher, data scientist, and business intelligence analyst. The program includes required courses in marketing analytics, research, and strategy, as well as a selection of elective courses in digital marketing, consumer behavior, and other areas. The Master of Science in Marketing is a STEM-designated program.
Program name: Master of Science in Marketing

description: The Master of Science in Social Entrepreneurship (MSSE) is a one-year, full-time accelerated program for students passionate about creating innovative solutions to global problems. The program draws upon the core competencies of the Marshall School of Business, the School of Social Work, and the Price School of Public Policy, and the Annenberg School of Communication. By combining theory with experiential learning, the program seeks to develop leaders with the skills to address societal needs through market-based solutions. Graduates are prepared to launch their own social ventures, or lead social impact initiatives within existing organizations.
Program name: Master of Science in Social Entrepreneurship

description: The Master of Advanced Architectural Research Studies (MAARS) is a post-professional research degree for students who hold a professional degree in architecture or landscape architecture. The program provides the opportunity for students to undertake intensive directed research in one of three areas of specialization: City Design and Housing, Building Science, or Digital Technologies. The City Design and Housing specialization focuses on urban design and housing in the context of architecture, urbanism, and landscape, exploring the role of design within these fields in response to contemporary challenges. Its primary objective is to equip students with critical research skills to engage pressing social and environmental issues through design, analysis, and representation. The Master of Advanced Architectural Research Studies (City Design and Housing) offers an opportunity for a focused period of study in one of the important areas of current architectural thinking and practice for candidates who already possess a professional degree. The curriculum is comprised of core courses in architectural research and methods, as well as highly focused elective coursework and an intensive individual research project or thesis.
Program name: Master of Advanced Architectural Research Studies (City Design and Housing)

description: The Master of Advanced Architectural Research Studies (MAARS) is a one-year post-professional degree that allows students to explore issues specific to emerging themes in architectural design and technology. The curriculum is a combination of advanced research topics, design research and electives, all leading to a final research project that culminates in a master’s thesis. The MAARS program is open to applicants who hold a professional degree in Architecture (BArch or MArch), Landscape Architecture, Urban Planning, or a related field. The MAARS program in Performative Design and Technology focuses on the performance-driven design of the built environment. It explores the relationship between architectural space and human experience by examining the interactions between formal systems, environmental parameters, and their social context. Through advanced digital tools, students engage in novel computational strategies that explore the integration of design, simulation, and fabrication, thus contributing to the generation of innovative design practices that address environmental and social challenges.
Program name: Master of Advanced Architectural Research Studies (Performative Design and Technology)

description: The Master of Advanced Architectural Studies (MAAS) program is a post-professional graduate program designed for students who hold an accredited professional degree in architecture (B.Arch or M.Arch) and wish to undertake advanced research in a specialized area of architectural studies. The program culminates in a significant design research project, a written thesis, or a design thesis, which addresses a specific architectural problem or theoretical position. Through advanced seminars, studio work, and independent study, students develop expertise in a chosen research area and contribute to the discourse of architecture.
Program name: Master of Advanced Architectural Studies
Master of Architecture

description: The Master of Building Science (MBS) program is an advanced, interdisciplinary degree program that offers an intensive deep dive into building systems, materials, and advanced computational tools and simulation for high-performance and sustainable building design. The program combines scientific principles with architectural design, preparing graduates for leadership roles in architectural firms, engineering consultancies, and research institutions focused on sustainable building practices. Students will learn to critically analyze building performance, develop innovative solutions for energy efficiency and environmental quality, and apply cutting-edge technologies to create resilient and intelligent buildings. The MBS curriculum integrates theoretical knowledge with practical application, culminating in a research project or capstone design that addresses real-world building challenges.
Program name: Master of Building Science

description: The Master of Heritage Conservation (MHC) is a two-year post-professional degree program dedicated to preparing students for leadership roles in the interdisciplinary field of heritage conservation. Students engage with critical issues related to the protection, preservation, and management of cultural heritage resources globally and locally. The curriculum encompasses a broad range of topics, including conservation theory and ethics, historical research methods, building materials conservation, cultural landscape studies, planning and policy, economics of preservation, and digital heritage. Through a blend of rigorous academic coursework, hands-on fieldwork, professional workshops, and engagement with leading practitioners, students develop the analytical, technical, and practical skills necessary to navigate complex conservation challenges. The program emphasizes innovative approaches to sustaining historic places and cultural landscapes, fostering critical thinking about heritage values, and preparing graduates to work in governmental agencies, non-profit organizations, private consulting firms, and international heritage bodies.
Program name: Master of Heritage Conservation

description: Welcome to the USC Master of Landscape Architecture (MLA) Program! Our dynamic, internationally-recognized, and professionally-accredited Master of Landscape Architecture program prepares students for leadership in an expanding field through innovative design, rigorous research, and robust interdisciplinary collaboration. The USC MLA is a three-year, first-professional degree program that teaches students how to address the most urgent environmental and social challenges of our time, creating resilient and beautiful futures through the design of parks, cities, infrastructures, and ecosystems. The MLA program is committed to a diverse student body, faculty, and curriculum. Our program offers students opportunities to work with students and faculty in a wide range of disciplines, including architecture, urban planning, real estate development, building science, fine arts, public health, cinematic arts, and other fields across the university.
Accreditation status: The USC Master of Landscape Architecture program is accredited by the Landscape Architectural Accreditation Board (LAAB).
Program name: Master of Landscape Architecture

description: The Master of Fine Arts program in Animation and Digital Arts is an intensive three-year program designed to develop accomplished artists for careers in animation and the digital arts. The program provides a grounding in the fundamentals of animation and digital arts, and fosters personal artistic vision and skills. Students are able to explore multiple areas of animation and digital arts, including animation production, interactive media, motion graphics, visual effects, and game art. The curriculum culminates in the development of a significant thesis project in the student's area of interest.
Program name: Master of Fine Arts in Animation and Digital Arts

description: The Master of Arts in Cinema and Media Studies is designed for students seeking an intensive course of study in the history, theory and aesthetics of cinema and related media, and in their social and cultural impact. The MA program provides students with rigorous training in critical studies, the opportunity to study with an internationally recognized faculty, and engagement with the rich intellectual community of the USC School of Cinematic Arts. The program prepares students for continued graduate work toward a PhD, for careers in teaching at the community college level, and for work in a variety of related fields including journalism, festivals, exhibition, archives, arts administration, publishing, and other media-related professions. The MA program provides students with opportunities to engage in a wide range of critical and theoretical approaches to the study of media, including historical and archival study, feminist film and media theory, critical race and ethnic studies, classical and contemporary film theory, television studies, new media studies, sound studies, global cinema, and transmedia storytelling. The program requires 32 units of course work, including a thesis. The degree is awarded under the jurisdiction of the Graduate School.
Program name: Master of Arts in Cinema and Media Studies

description: The Master of Arts in Cinematic Arts (Media Arts, Games and Health) explores the evolving fields of serious games, health media, and new frontiers in interactive and immersive experience design. Combining human-centered design, deep research, and agile production, students learn how to create interactive and immersive experiences for health and well-being. The program offers a core in interactive media literacy, game design, and health communication, alongside opportunities to apply these skills by building new experiences with clients and community partners. Our students develop a unique portfolio of work that demonstrates their fluency across multiple interactive media platforms and technologies. Upon graduation, students will be prepared for a variety of roles across the health care, media, and technology sectors.
Program name: Master of Arts in Cinematic Arts (Media Arts, Games and Health)

description: The USC School of Cinematic Arts has consistently been ranked as the #1 film school in the world. Our production students learn the craft of cinematic storytelling by making movies and television shows. Our goal is to prepare them to work as directors, producers, cinematographers, editors, sound designers, production designers and interactive artists. While most film school programs focus on teaching students to work as crew members, our emphasis is on the creative elements of storytelling. The program teaches a common cinematic language, enabling directors to communicate with writers, cinematographers with sound designers, and all of them to speak with producers. Students are encouraged to explore personal visions and to develop unique voices. They will work together to make award-winning films and television shows while at USC and beyond.
Program name: Master of Fine Arts in Cinematic Arts, Film and Television Production
Master of Fine Arts in Expanded Animation Research and Practice

description: The Master of Science in Game Design and Development program is designed to train students in the core principles of game design and production, with an emphasis on creating innovative and engaging interactive experiences. Students will learn how to lead game development teams, manage production pipelines, and design compelling game systems and mechanics. The curriculum covers a range of topics including game theory, level design, systems design, narrative design, user experience, and project management. The program culminates in a significant game project, providing students with practical experience in developing and launching a game. Graduates will be prepared for leadership roles in the game industry, as well as for entrepreneurial ventures.
Program name: Master of Science in Game Design and Development

description: The Master of Fine Arts in Interactive Media (Games and Health) is designed for students with a strong interest in the design and development of interactive experiences that promote health and well-being. This two-year, 48-unit program trains students to create interactive experiences, including games, that address health-related challenges and promote positive health behaviors. Students gain expertise in game design, interactive narrative, user experience (UX) design, data analysis, and the psychological and social aspects of health. The program emphasizes an interdisciplinary approach, drawing upon faculty expertise from various fields, including game design, cinematic arts, engineering, and health sciences.
Program name: Master of Fine Arts in Interactive Media (Games and Health)

description: The Master of Fine Arts in Interactive Media is a three-year graduate program in the Interactive Media Division of the School of Cinematic Arts. The program prepares students to become leaders in the field of interactive media, with an emphasis on creating new forms of interactive entertainment, education, and communication. Students are encouraged to explore the rich tradition of creativity in the School of Cinematic Arts and to develop their own unique voice in the interactive space. The program is designed for students with a wide range of backgrounds, from computer science to fine arts, and provides a rigorous interdisciplinary curriculum that combines theory and practice.
Program name: Master of Fine Arts in Interactive Media

description: The M.F.A. in Producing program is a three-year graduate conservatory program designed to train students for creative leadership positions in the film, television and new media industries. Students in the program are challenged to develop into creative producers who can identify a good story, package it for the marketplace, put together a creative team, and guide a project from conception through distribution. The program offers training in creative project development, physical production, finance, marketing and distribution in both the independent and studio worlds. In addition, the program encourages students to take advantage of the many opportunities available in the convergence of all forms of media, and to seek new models of producing for interactive and multi-platform content. At the core of the producing program is a philosophy that emphasizes artistic vision, entrepreneurship, and collaboration. Through a combination of rigorous coursework, thesis projects, and internships, students are prepared to lead the way into the ever-evolving future of entertainment.
Program name: Master of Fine Arts in Producing for Film, Television, and New Media

description: The John Wells Division of Writing for Screen & Television at the USC School of Cinematic Arts has consistently been recognized as one of the top writing programs in the world. Our mission is to provide students with the necessary tools, skills, and industry insights to become successful, professional writers for film, television, and other emerging media. We offer a rigorous and immersive curriculum designed to foster creativity, critical thinking, and collaboration, preparing graduates for dynamic careers in the entertainment industry. At the heart of our program is the belief that great writing begins with great storytelling. We emphasize developing a strong narrative voice, understanding character dynamics, mastering structure, and adapting to the evolving landscape of media. Students engage in intensive workshops, receive individualized mentorship from experienced faculty—many of whom are active, award-winning professionals in the industry—and gain practical experience through numerous production opportunities. We encourage a diverse range of voices and perspectives, believing that compelling stories come from varied experiences. Our comprehensive curriculum covers everything from feature film screenwriting, television episodic writing, and showrunning to documentary writing and new media content creation.
Program name: Master of Fine Arts in Writing for Screen and Television

description: The Business Analytics graduate certificate is designed to provide students with the foundational knowledge and analytical tools necessary to understand the business value of data and to apply quantitative methods, data analysis, and predictive modeling to solve business problems. Students will develop skills in the areas of data mining, machine learning, and statistical analysis, as well as an understanding of how to communicate complex analytical results to various audiences.
Program name: Business Analytics Graduate Certificate

description: The Financial Analysis and Valuation Graduate Certificate prepares students for careers in financial analysis and valuation, investment management, and corporate finance. This includes positions such as financial analyst, portfolio manager, credit analyst, and investment banker. Students learn how to analyze the financial health of firms, forecast their future performance, value debt and equity, and make investment recommendations.
Program name: Financial Analysis and Valuation Graduate Certificate

description: This graduate certificate provides specialized training in the knowledge, skills, and values required to work in libraries and other information organizations. The certificate focuses on both foundational principles and the application of cutting-edge technologies. The curriculum provides core competencies needed for a range of professional positions in areas such as information services, collection management, information organization, and leadership. Students completing the certificate will be prepared to critically evaluate, develop, and implement solutions to address challenges in managing information and connecting users to information resources within libraries and related contexts.
Program name: Library and Information Management Graduate Certificate

description: The graduate certificate in Management Studies is designed to provide students with the fundamental business and management skills necessary to be successful in a wide range of industries and professional pursuits. The program focuses on developing managerial decision-making and leadership skills, along with an understanding of organizational behavior, marketing, and finance. It is intended for individuals who want to enhance their business acumen without committing to a full master's degree program, or for those who want to supplement their existing graduate studies with a strong foundation in management.
Program name: Management Studies Graduate Certificate

description: The Marketing graduate certificate provides students with core competencies in marketing strategy and marketing analytics. The certificate is especially useful for students in master’s programs in disciplines other than business to gain a fundamental understanding of marketing, or for business students interested in a focused study of marketing. It also provides an excellent foundation for those considering further graduate study in marketing.
Program name: Marketing Graduate Certificate

description: This graduate certificate provides students with a strong background in optimization theory and its applications to supply chain management. The certificate provides tools for students who want to develop, implement and use optimization models and solution methodologies for complex supply chain problems such as demand forecasting, capacity planning, production scheduling, inventory management, logistics and transportation. Students who successfully complete the certificate will be prepared to work as supply chain analysts, consultants and managers in manufacturing, retail, transportation and logistics industries.
Program name: Optimization and Supply Chain Management Graduate Certificate

description: This graduate certificate provides students with core knowledge and skills required for careers in strategy and management consulting. Students learn how to structure and analyze complex business problems, develop innovative solutions, and effectively communicate recommendations to clients. The program emphasizes practical application through case studies, industry projects, and guest speakers from leading consulting firms. Graduates will be well-prepared for roles in management consulting, internal strategy, business development, and related fields.
Program name: Strategy and Management Consulting Graduate Certificate

description: This concentration focuses on how businesses can contribute to a sustainable future by creating innovative and economically viable solutions to global environmental and societal challenges. Students will learn how to lead business strategy in sustainable development by gaining expertise in relevant issues such as climate change, natural resource management, energy, social responsibility, sustainable operations and supply chains, green marketing, social entrepreneurship, and impact investing. Additionally, the curriculum provides opportunities to gain practical experience and network with sustainability leaders in the Los Angeles business community.
Program name: Sustainability and Business Graduate Certificate

description: The Technology Commercialization Graduate Certificate program provides a rigorous educational experience focused on the process of bringing new technologies to market. This includes invention, intellectual property, market analysis, business plan development, team building and raising capital. This certificate emphasizes innovation management from the perspective of both start-up ventures and large corporations seeking to develop new products. This certificate is open to all graduate students and includes participants from the Viterbi School of Engineering, Marshall School of Business, Gould School of Law and the Keck School of Medicine of USC. This 12-unit certificate can also be stacked to meet the requirements of an M.S. in Product Development or an MBA.
Program name: Technology Commercialization Graduate Certificate

description: The Herman Ostrow School of Dentistry of USC is one of the oldest and largest dental schools in the United States. Its Doctor of Dental Surgery (DDS) program has a distinguished history of educating leaders in dental education, research, and practice. The Ostrow School is known for its strong clinical program, which provides students with extensive hands-on experience treating a diverse patient population. The DDS program prepares students for a career as a general dentist and provides the foundation for those interested in pursuing post-doctoral specialty training. Its distinguished faculty members are nationally and internationally recognized for their expertise in a wide range of dental disciplines. The school’s robust research program, which covers areas from craniofacial biology to community oral health, offers students the opportunity to participate in cutting-edge scientific inquiry.
Accreditation status: The Herman Ostrow School of Dentistry of USC is accredited by the Commission on Dental Accreditation (CODA) of the American Dental Association. The commission is a specialized accrediting body recognized by the United States Department of Education.
Program name: Doctor of Dental Surgery

description: The Juris Doctor (JD) is a professional doctorate degree that prepares graduates for careers in law. Most students complete the JD degree in three years of full-time study. Successful completion of the degree requires students to acquire knowledge and understanding of substantive law, legal analysis and reasoning, legal research, problem solving, oral and written communication, client counseling, and ethical and professional principles governing law practice. The degree is a prerequisite for taking the bar examination in most U.S. states and territories. The JD program does not offer specific concentrations or specializations. Students may focus their studies through choices of elective courses and participation in student organizations and clinical programs.
Accreditation status: The Gould School of Law is approved by the American Bar Association (ABA).
Program name: Juris Doctor

description: The Keck School of Medicine of USC is committed to the education of future physicians and biomedical scientists and to the discovery of new knowledge in the basic and clinical sciences. Through innovative research, excellence in patient care and the education of the next generation of leaders, the Keck School of Medicine of USC is defining the future of medicine. Our mission is to improve the quality of life for individuals and society by promoting health, preventing and treating disease, advancing biomedical research and educating tomorrow’s physicians and scientists. The Doctor of Medicine (MD) program at the Keck School of Medicine of USC provides a comprehensive medical education that integrates basic sciences with clinical experience from day one. Our innovative curriculum prepares students for the challenges and advancements of modern medicine, fostering critical thinking, compassion, and leadership. Students learn in diverse clinical settings, including large academic medical centers, county hospitals, and community clinics, serving a wide range of patient populations. The program emphasizes personalized learning, research opportunities, and community engagement, ensuring graduates are well-rounded, skilled, and socially conscious physicians ready to make a significant impact on healthcare.
Accreditation status: The Keck School of Medicine of USC is accredited by the Liaison Committee on Medical Education (LCME). The LCME is the nationally recognized accrediting authority for medical education programs leading to the M.D. degree in the United States and Canada.
Program name: Doctor of Medicine
